title: A great job of spreading our heritage in Jaén ¡De 10!
text:
We took a guided tour within a group of 9 people to the Cathedral, Arab Baths and Jaén air raid shelter and were amazed by the wonders that our land has and that we did not know in part. 
Maria, our guide, was a charming, punctual, pleasant and her explanations were wonderful.
I requested a birthday gift card for my companion and they sent it to me so I could print it.
It will not be the first or the last activity you have with them because we are delighted.

THANK YOU!
author: aimuela

title: An exciting visit
text:
Excellent visit the city of Jaén thanks to our guide Kevin; you rating that he is a great professional and enthusiast of his work, and that transmits it to the whole group. 
We loved the whole guide as it makes a perfect balance between history, art and anecdotes, which makes it very enjoyable and fun. I definitely recommend this visit as it allows you to get to know a little better the incredible history of this city as unknown as it is exciting.
